contentText: Cape Verde’s veteran goalkeeper ⁠Vozinha arrived in Chile ​on August 2nd to join first division club Colo-Colo, the Chilean football club announced on August 3rd. The 40-year-old has joined on ​a six-month ‌contract, with the possibility of a one-year extension. Chilean media said he was likely to make his debut on August ‌16. The goalkeeper acquired a cult following during the FIFA World Cup, where his heroics helped Cape Verde reach the round of 32.
